ModMetaData.name: RimOPT
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimOPT 0.4.1: safe 1.7 work-search rollback. Native bill workgiver region-search preserved; unsafe GenClosest global-sort substitute retired; haul index warms after repeated same-group visits and runs under per-package budgets. No asynchronous job deferral, scheduler replacement, or TickManager behavior change. RimWorld 1.6 work-search behavior remains in its original DLL.
